answer: Stop sybils with a reef mirror ripple: an agent stakes a bond for one reef mirror. Each cycle it casts a ripple across the mirror and files its echo; verifiers match the echo to the reef wall, voiding a mirror whose ripple is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 mirrors at 18x: each ripple fits one reef and one mirror, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents cast once and keep rights.
